scheme_name: Self-Employment Scheme For Dependents Of Prisoners
other_conditions: Applicant must be a native and resident of Kerala
Applicant must belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category
Family must have a convict who has served imprisonment of 5 years or more
Assistance is available only during the period of the convict’s imprisonment
Applicant must not have previously received financial assistance for the same purpose
Priority is given to dependents such as husband/wife, unemployed and unmarried son/daughter
Other eligible dependents include widowed/divorced/abandoned daughters and parents (father/mother) below 55 years of age
benefits_summary: Maximum financial assistance of ₹30,000 per family, provided only once.
